factors.name: Reaction at a strong fresh zone
factors.call: ms.trend >= 0 and zn.dz_since <= 2 and zn.dz_tests <= 2 and zn.dz_move >= 1.2 and zn.room_up >= 1.5 and green and body > 0.5 * range and close > high[1] and close > zn.dz_hi and low >= zn.dz_lo
factors.put: ms.trend <= 0 and zn.sz_since <= 2 and zn.sz_tests <= 2 and zn.sz_move >= 1.2 and zn.room_dn >= 1.5 and red and body < -0.5 * range and close < low[1] and close < zn.sz_lo and high <= zn.sz_hi

factors.name: Break of a visited zone
factors.call: ms.trend >= 0 and zn.sz_since[1] <= 1 and zn.sz_tests[1] >= 1 and close[1] <= zn.sz_hi[1] and close > zn.sz_hi[1] + 0.3 * a14 and green and body > 0.6 * range and upper_wick < 0.2 * range
factors.put: ms.trend <= 0 and zn.dz_since[1] <= 1 and zn.dz_tests[1] >= 1 and close[1] >= zn.dz_lo[1] and close < zn.dz_lo[1] - 0.3 * a14 and red and body < -0.6 * range and lower_wick < 0.2 * range

factors.name: Role-reversal retest
factors.call: ms.trend >= 0 and zn.dz_flip == 1 and zn.dz_since <= 2 and zn.dz_tests <= 1 and green and body > 0.5 * range and close > high[1] and close > zn.dz_hi
factors.put: ms.trend <= 0 and zn.sz_flip == 1 and zn.sz_since <= 2 and zn.sz_tests <= 1 and red and body < -0.5 * range and close < low[1] and close < zn.sz_lo
